## Research/software change

Describe the question and the exact boundary changed.

## Verification

- [ ] Analytical or metamorphic regression added where appropriate
- [ ] Tests, lint, formatting and type checks pass
- [ ] Reproduction command and any changed assumptions documented
- [ ] No secrets, private data or unsupported validation claims
- [ ] Source licences and attribution checked for new inputs
- [ ] README and roadmap stage/status updated, including remaining work
- [ ] Portfolio case study and its README updated (link PR/commit, or state blocker)
- [ ] GUI regression/browser checks performed for interface changes
- [ ] Maintainer publication check: both repos pushed, CI checked, Pages verified
